overall.description: A person walks along gravel and paved paths through a lush green alpine village, passing traditional wooden chalets and enjoying panoramic views of a deep valley with dramatic mountain cliffs and a small town below. The overcast sky casts diffused light over the vibrant meadows and forested slopes as the walker ascends stone steps toward more hillside buildings.
